caption: The drawing displays a textile or wallpaper design featuring a large central floral motif with a prominent, stylized red flower and several surrounding smaller blossoms and buds, all accented by brownish-green leaves. The central section of the design has a beige background that is filled with a network of small, irregular, wavy lines and subtle, lighter floral elements to create texture. On either side of the central floral area, there are vertical borders that contain a repeating pattern of red flowers with white centers, black backgrounds, and surrounding white curvilinear shapes. The overall color palette consists mainly of red, deep rose, brown, beige, muted green, and white. The various elements are outlined and detailed in dark brown or black, and the composition is symmetrical with respect to the decorative side borders. The entire drawing is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Chintz
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
